source: categories_test.go:TestRealFailures ("flavoured lip balm is topical, not edible")

raw.title: Indus Hemp: Lip Balm - Chocolate 5G
raw.description: Nourishing chocolate flavoured lip balm with hemp oil.

regression_note: 'Chocolate' is in the edible_solid word list, and cosmetic products routinely carry food-flavour names ('Lip Balm — Chocolate', 'Cocoa & Coffee Body Butter'). The coherence matrix runs topical's exclusion FIRST, before edible_solid's, specifically so a flavour name never outranks an explicit cosmetic-application word (balm/cream/lotion/etc.). Order matters here — reversing it would let 'chocolate' win.
